answer: Forging many sockpuppets means posting real collateral per identity, then risking slashing if coordination patterns flag. Sybil resistance here uses a staked-identity ledger: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers must co-sign any vouch. Like a river carving one channel, honest stake compounds; attackers burn capital at every fake summit of trust. Reputation decays toward the horizon unless renewed by genuine work, so cheap clones never reach meaningful weight. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
